content: Within six months, Sabrina will use a pincer grasp to pick up small objects (e.g., small finger foods) independently in 4 out of 5 opportunities, enhancing fine motor dexterity and adaptive skills during mealtime.
Within six months, Sabrina will climb a set of stairs (5-6 steps) with one railing support, alternating feet in 4 out of 5 opportunities, improving gross motor coordination and balance skills.
Within three months, Sabrina will complete a shape sorter with 4 different shapes independently in 4 out of 5 opportunities, demonstrating improved visual-motor integration and problem-solving.

Within four months, Sabrina will perform bilateral hand tasks (e.g., rolling play-dough into balls) by crossing midline with minimal prompts in 4 out of 5 opportunities, enhancing bilateral coordination for play activities.
Within six months, Sabrina will independently put on a simple pullover shirt (excluding fasteners) in 4 out of 5 attempts, promoting self-care and adaptive dressing skills.

Within four months, Sabrina will seek out and engage with at least one sensory-rich activity (e.g., sandbox play) during playtime with minimal cues in 4 out of 5 opportunities, supporting sensory exploration and regulation.
Within five months, Sabrina will imitate vertical and horizontal lines using a crayon in 4 out of 5 opportunities with moderate assistance, promoting pre-writing skills and tool use.

Within four months, Sabrina will engage in group play activities for at least 10 minutes with peers, requiring only 1-2 verbal prompts to share or take turns in 4 out of 5 play sessions, facilitating social participation and play skills.
